name: 60471 · Richton Park, IL
findings: ZIP 60471 (Richton Park) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (23%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Youth organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60471 (Richton Park) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60471 (Richton Park) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).
